summary.text: Edith Patterson is a Democratic member of the Maryland House of Delegates from District 28, which includes Charles County, and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
She has served in the House since 2015 and sits on the Ways and Means Committee.

paragraphs.text: Patterson was first elected to the House of Delegates in 2014 and has been a member since 2015.

She has served on the Ways and Means Committee since 2015; in 2026 she chairs its Gaming Subcommittee and serves on its K-12 Education Subcommittee, and from 2020 to 2025 she chaired its Racing and Gaming Subcommittee.

Her other assignments include the Joint Committee on Ending Homelessness, the Charles County House Delegation (which she chaired in 2021-2022) and the Southern Maryland House Delegation, which she has chaired since 2022.
She is a member of the Legislative Black Caucus of Maryland and the Maryland Veterans Caucus, and she was president of the Women Legislators of Maryland in 2023-2024.
